title: Potions++
description: Craftable potions that come with custom OP effects.
body:
## How it works

Every potion is a shapeless crafting-table recipe: `water bottle + the listed ingredient`.

These 17 potions are implemented:

| Potion | Secondary effect | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Regeneration | 8 golden apples on drink | consume mixin |
| Speed | freezes random tick speed | `ServerWorld#tickChunk` mixin |
| Fire Resistance | sets hit entities on fire | attack event |
| Healing | absorption if drunk at full HP | consume mixin |
| Night Vision | all other entities glow | server tick |
| Strength | diamond axe on drink | consume mixin |
| Jump Boost | other players can't jump | jump-strength attribute |
| Water Breathing | + Conduit Power | server tick |
| Invisibility | armour & held items vanish too | client render mixins |
| Slow Falling | fall-damage immunity, no float | custom `feather_fall` effect |
| Luck | 20% → 5 stacks per block | block-break event |
| Poison (splash) | + Weakness III | splash-collision mixin |
| Weakness (splash) | can't break blocks | block-break event |
| Slowness (splash) | spawns TNT on victims | splash-collision mixin |
| Harming (splash) | explodes on impact | splash-collision mixin |
| Withering (splash) | instakills everything hit | splash-collision mixin |

All potions can be created using a crafting table, or in the player inventory.
